name: Contraxx Furniture
old_description: “Impressive to see the level of craftsmanship and attention to detail in this furniture. Contraxx is a business founded on small town values that delivers world class quality to some of the most discerning clients in America.” – David W.
about:
Contraxx Furniture operates from McConnelsville, Ohio, where it has been producing custom hospitality furniture for more than three decades. The company developed its distinctive hub-and-spoke manufacturing system in the 1990s, aiming to keep furniture production jobs in the United States by networking independent craft shops.

The company manufactures custom casegoods, seating, banquettes, tables, beds, and lobby furniture for hotels, resorts, restaurants, casinos, and senior-living communities. Its distributed model connects more than 45 family-owned factories specializing in woodworking, metal fabrication, stone work, upholstery, and finishing, with final assembly and finishing performed in two company-operated factories. Every piece undergoes a 15-point quality assurance inspection, and no minimum order quantities are required.

Contraxx serves designers, architects, developers, and FF&E professionals across North America. Projects include boutique hotels such as The Pearl in Nantucket, the Elliott House Boutique Hotel in Charleston, and the Sheraton Grand in Los Angeles, as well as restaurants like Hank’s Seafood and 1587 Prime Steakhouse, and casino properties including Grand Casinos.

The company emphasizes its American-made supply chain, the flexibility of its hub-and-spoke network to handle projects of any scale, and a collaborative approach that preserves design intent from early engineering through installation. It positions itself as a partner for bespoke hospitality projects where custom design, craftsmanship, and reliable delivery are critical.
